# watsonx.ai

Use `watsonx/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "watsonx-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "watsonx/ibm/granite-4-h-small",
});
```

- `WATSONX_AI_APIKEY`
- `WATSONX_AI_PROJECT_ID`
